module: M7a/M7b defense + MGE/GI per-genome summary and group statistics (VFDB excluded, M7c agent)

defense_finder.db_version: defense-finder-models vers 3.1.0 + CasFinder (~/.macsyfinder/models, installed 2026-05-14, predates 2026-10-02 runs)
defense_finder.evidence: env export results_revision_20261001/12_delivery/envs_export/defense-finder.yml; current env pip metadata identical

genomad.evidence: per-genome log header 'Executing geNomad annotate (v1.12.0)'; env export genomad.yml

mob_suite.evidence: per-genome log 'MOB-recon version 3.1.9'; current env pip metadata identical

integron_finder.evidence: per-genome log 'integron_finder version 2.0.6'; env export integron_finder.yml

isescan.evidence: env export isescan.yml; current env isescan.py --version = 1.7.3

randomness: none (KW, Fisher exact, Wilson, OLS are deterministic; no permutation in this module)

statistical_conventions.run_status: success_hits/success_empty = parsed cleanly (hits or zero hits); failed = evidence present but parse error; missing = no evidence file. Failures are never written as 0.
statistical_conventions.wilson_ci: z=qnorm(0.975), standard Wilson score interval on the evaluable binomial denominator
statistical_conventions.kw: stats::kruskal.test; BH q within exactly the three prespecified burden omnibus tests per analysis_id; epsilon2=max(0,(H-k+1)/(n-k)) with untruncated value also reported
statistical_conventions.fisher: stats::fisher.test two-sided, conditional MLE OR/CI; rows=target/rest, cols=present/absent; a=target present etc.; carrier_total>=5 prespecified filter; BH family defense_prevalence (main) and defense_prevalence_participant_subset (sensitivity, corrected separately)
statistical_conventions.assembly_model: rank(n_complete_systems, ties.average) ~ species_group + assembly_class + log1p(n_contigs) + genome_size_Mb; coefficients in rank units; partial F of species_group vs assembly-covariate-only model; does NOT adjust for phylogenetic or study-source confounding
statistical_conventions.flavescens_n7: no strong negative/specificity claims for the 7-genome group
